title: Core: library duplicate symbol + rename
description: Implement library item operations in packages/core/src/engine/library.ts. Functions: duplicateLibraryItem(doc, itemId) - deep clone a Symbol/BitmapItem/SoundItem with new id and name like 'Copy of Foo'; renameLibraryItem(doc, itemId, newName) - rename; deleteLibraryItem(doc, itemId) - remove from library (also remove all SymbolInstances that reference it from all frames). All immutable, return new FlashDocument. Add unit tests.
